title: scope/reaction notification settings are sent as a full object built from the session snapshot, so two quick toggles lose the first
trigger: Open Notifications defaults; toggle 'Show message preview' then, before TDLib's updateScopeNotificationSettings arrives, toggle 'Notify about mentions' for the same scope (same for apply_reaction_*)
effect: The second send carries the old preview value, so the server ends with the first change reverted and the switch snaps back
fix: Keep a per-scope Edit stage (draft + request id) in the settings ui and merge the next field into the in-flight draft, or send field-level patches

title: Pay on a composer paid-send confirmation resubmits the text, which opens the same confirmation again unless 'Don't ask me again' is ticked
trigger: Live account; open a chat whose other side charges Stars; type text and Send; the Confirm payment box opens; leave 'Don't ask me again' unticked and press Pay
effect: confirm_paid_send replaces the stage with None and calls submit_composer, whose live branch (composer/mod.rs:174) calls paid_send_waits again; needs_confirmation is still true (the price is not trusted), so a new Composer stage is made and the box reopens. The message never goes out unless the user ticks the trust box (which stores a price they did not want to remember). The unit tests run on the demo session where `plan` is None and the check is skipped
fix: Make Pay hand the submit an 'agreed for this send' value (a field of the Composer stage carried into the one resubmit) that paid_send_waits honours once, or send through the PaidGuard release path instead of resubmitting

title: avatar decode 'in flight' is a thread_local map entry (empty Vec) with no Task, cleared only by a detached task
trigger: A first notification for an avatar starts the decode; if the app task never reaches the remove (spawn_app task dropped, app update failing before the remove)
effect: No bug today; later notifications for that photo path queue behind a decode nobody will finish and never show
fix: Hold the decode as a stage (Decoding { job: Task }) in NotifyDelivery keyed by path, so dropping it ends the wait

title: poll loop is a detached task named by connect.generation instead of a task held by the client
trigger: restart_live_connection / client replaced: the old loop ends only when it next wakes and compares generation
fix: hold the poll Task in the LiveConnect stage so replacing the client cancels it
